methodology: Only official auction-house sources are used for published buyer-term fields. Sale- or location-specific terms are labelled as such.

houses.name: Christie's
houses.scope: Global standard auctions; thresholds vary by sale site
houses.buyersPremium: 28% / 22% / 15% cumulative tiers; effective 1 Sep 2026. Thresholds vary by sale site.
houses.paymentDeadline: Live auctions: within 7 days. Online auctions: immediately.
houses.registration: Identity verification required; Christie’s recommends live-auction registration at least 24 hours before start. Financial reference/deposit may be requested.
houses.kyc: Government photo ID + proof of residential address; organisations require incorporation/ownership/authorisation documents.
houses.movement: Invoice may note export and/or CITES permit requirements; international duties/taxes are destination-specific.

houses.name: Sotheby's
houses.scope: Global auctions; thresholds vary by sale location
houses.buyersPremium: 28% / 22% / 15% cumulative tiers for major art-auction locations; thresholds vary by currency/location. Wines differ.
houses.paymentDeadline: Standard buyer guide states payment is required immediately after the auction; some eligible invoices use scheduled payment thresholds.
houses.registration: Complete account profile 24 hours before auction; some premium lots require additional financial verification.
houses.kyc: Government-issued photo ID + proof of address; KYC can also be refreshed before registration or release.
houses.movement: Taxes depend on sale location and receipt method; catalogue symbols flag restricted materials, heritage lots and other special cases.

houses.name: Phillips
houses.scope: Major live/online auctions; thresholds and tax treatment vary by location
houses.buyersPremium: 27% / 21% / 14.5% cumulative tiers shown in 2026 sale terms; thresholds vary by sale currency/location.
houses.paymentDeadline: Phillips Hong Kong payment guidance states payment is due immediately following the sale.
houses.registration: Register for each sale; Phillips guidance recommends registration at least 24 hours before live auctions.
houses.kyc: Photo ID and proof of address used for KYC / identity verification.
houses.movement: Sale pages may flag tariffs/import issues; collection/shipping and tax treatment are sale/location specific.

houses.name: AstaGuru
houses.scope: India-based auctions; sale particulars can change by category
houses.buyersPremium: Sale-specific — verify the relevant catalogue / conditions before bidding.
houses.paymentDeadline: Current public terms reviewed; exact payment timing should be verified against the relevant sale conditions.
houses.registration: New bidders should register and complete verification at least 4 business days before the auction date.
houses.kyc: May require government ID, proof of residence, PAN/Aadhaar/tax-residency information, source-of-funds information and entity documents.
houses.movement: Buyer should check applicable statutory compliance and shipping/export requirements for the specific lot.

houses.name: Saffronart
houses.buyersPremium: Sale-specific. One currently indexed art-auction conditions page states 20% up to INR 300,000,000 and 15% above that; verify the actual sale conditions.
houses.paymentDeadline: Verify in the specific sale conditions before bidding.
houses.registration: Invoice details supplied at registration are used for the winning-bidder invoice.
houses.kyc: Sale/account-specific verification requirements should be checked directly with Saffronart.
houses.movement: For lots located in India, invoicing currency depends on buyer location; taxes, shipping, handling and duties may apply.

houses.name: Pundole's
houses.buyersPremium: Buyer’s premium applies; current buying page should be checked for the sale-specific rate.
houses.paymentDeadline: 25% hammer-price deposit within 3 working days; balance payment within 14 days after sale or deposit may be forfeited.
houses.registration: All buyers must register in advance; telephone arrangements are requested at least 24 hours before the auction.
houses.kyc: Registration required; invoicing details are tied to the registration form.
houses.movement: Buyer is responsible for duties/taxes; imported lots marked # may attract import duty and GST treatment described on the buying page.

houses.name: Bonhams
houses.buyersPremium: Research queued — current rates vary by location/sale and should be taken from the live sale information.
houses.paymentDeadline: Research queued — verify the specific sale’s Buyer’s Agreement.
houses.movement: Sale information can include VAT/import/CITES and storage requirements.
